picks.headline: New Edison Research study: audiobook listeners are willing to try AI multi-cast narration and rate it favorably
picks.excerpt: A blind Edison Research study found audiobook listeners rated AI multi-cast narration favorably against single human narrators on character-driven scenes, though with notable caveats. A concrete data point on whether synthetic voices can win over listeners as AI narration moves from novelty to shipping product.
picks.rationale: Net-new, distinct URL and content from every published books card. A blind listener study rating AI multi-cast narration favorably against human narrators gives authors and publishers hard data on when synthetic audiobook voices are viable — directly informing production decisions.
